value_stream.name: Government Affairs, Public Policy & Industry Relations

fields.Participants: Govt Affairs Mgr, VP Legal & Compliance, affected business units, Procurement/Finance (links to VS-34/VS-17.1)
fields.Volume: Portfolio of memberships (retail, chambers, supply-chain, sector)

workflows.name: Industry Association Membership Strategy, Selection & Dues Management

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-assign of "assign BuildRight representatives and engagement plan per association" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-track of "track membership utilization and ROI" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-542 (ensure controlled execution — Industry & Trade Association Relations (PA-104.2).)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Wasted-dues risk**: Memberships underused; mitigated by ROI evaluation (W3367)
- **Misaligned-membership risk**: Joining associations inconsistent with BuildRight values/strategy; mitigated by review
System Touchpoints: - Membership tracking; AP/dues (links to VS-34/VS-17.1); records (links to VS-88)

steps.activity: Govt Affairs Mgr maintain the membership strategy and portfolio: assess each association's value (advocacy access, benchmarking, standards, networking, brand) vs cost (dues, time); select/maintain/exit memberships

Govt Affairs Mgr/Procurement manage dues, contracts, and renewals (links to VS-34.2); approve per authority matrix (links to VS-36); assign BuildRight representatives and engagement plan per association
Govt Affairs Mgr track membership utilization and ROI (W3367), and report the portfolio to leadership; coordinate labor-association engagement (ECOP/FWE) with labor relations (links to VS-84.3 W2893)

fields.Participants: Govt Affairs Mgr, Leadership/Executives (representatives), VP Legal & Compliance

workflows.name: Trade Association Leadership, Committee & Board Representation

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-identify of "identify and nominate representatives" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-report of "report insights back to BuildRight" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-generate of "footprint and influence, manage conflicts-of-interest" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-542 (ensure controlled execution — Industry & Trade Association Relations (PA-104.2).)
- operational: engagement tracking; operational: COI review
Pain Points / Risks: - **Token-representation risk**: Seats held without active participation; mitigated by engagement tracking
- **Conflict-of-interest risk**: Role conflicts with BuildRight interest (links to VS-86.3); mitigated by COI review
System Touchpoints: - Association engagement record; records (links to VS-88); ethics/COI (links to VS-86.3/VS-100)

steps.activity: Govt Affairs Mgr pursue and manage BuildRight leadership roles in associations (board seats, committee chairs, working-group leads) where strategically valuable; identify and nominate representatives

Representatives participate actively (board/committee meetings, votes, working groups), advance BuildRight and industry interests, and report insights back to BuildRight; Govt Affairs Mgr supports briefings
Govt Affairs Mgr track BuildRight's leadership footprint and influence, manage conflicts-of-interest (links to VS-86.3/W3275 in VS-100.3), and assess continuation of roles

fields.Participants: Govt Affairs Mgr, affected SMEs (Quality per VS-31, Sustainability per VS-25, Privacy per VS-91, Tax per VS-79), Legal (links to VS-100)

workflows.name: Industry Standard, Code & Best-Practice Development Participation

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-identify of "identify standards/code/best-practice initiatives relevant to BuildRight" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-track of "Govt Affairs Mgr cascade adopted standards/codes to compliance readiness" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-542 (ensure controlled execution — Industry & Trade Association Relations (PA-104.2).)
- operational: horizon scanning (W3354); operational: early engagement
Pain Points / Risks: - **Standards-blindness risk**: Unaware of developing standards that later bind BuildRight; mitigated by horizon scanning (W3354)
- **Late-influence risk**: Joining development too late to shape outcome; mitigated by early engagement
System Touchpoints: - Standards tracking; compliance (links to VS-22.3/VS-31); records (links to VS-88)

steps.activity: Govt Affairs Mgr identify standards/code/best-practice initiatives relevant to BuildRight (product safety/DTI-BPS links to VS-31/VS-89, sustainability/BERDE links to VS-25/VS-78, data privacy links to VS-91, retail/ecommerce codes) and engage SMEs
SMEs/Govt Affairs Mgr participate in development (working groups, public comment, pilots), contribute BuildRight's expertise and data, and advocate for practical, BuildRight-favorable outcomes
Govt Affairs Mgr cascade adopted standards/codes to compliance readiness (links to VS-22.3/VS-31), capture BuildRight's contribution, and track adoption/impact (W3368)

fields.Participants: Govt Affairs Mgr, Strategy (links to VS-33.3), Market Research (links to VS-44.2), affected SMEs, Legal (links to VS-86 antitrust)

workflows.name: Peer-Retailer Benchmarking, Knowledge Exchange & Industry Research

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-identify of "identify benchmarking and knowledge-exchange opportunities via associations and…" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-log of "technology, sustainability, people" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-track of "Govt Affairs Mgr/Strategy disseminate insights internally" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-542 (ensure controlled execution — Industry & Trade Association Relations (PA-104.2).)
- operational: legal guardrails; operational: dissemination and tracking
Pain Points / Risks: - **Antitrust risk**: Improper information exchange with competitors (links to VS-86); mitigated by legal guardrails
- **Insight-non-use risk**: Benchmarks captured but not applied; mitigated by dissemination and tracking
System Touchpoints: - Benchmarking/analytics (links to VS-28.1/VS-33.3); antitrust (links to VS-86); records (links to VS-88)

steps.activity: Govt Affairs Mgr/Strategy identify benchmarking and knowledge-exchange opportunities via associations and peer networks (retail operations, supply chain, digital, sustainability, HR); scope within antitrust limits (links to VS-86)
SMEs participate in exchanges/benchmarking studies, share non-proprietary practices, and capture insights (operations, technology, sustainability, people) for BuildRight improvement
Govt Affairs Mgr/Strategy disseminate insights internally (links to VS-33.3 competitive intelligence, VS-30 innovation), translate to improvement initiatives, and track application (W3368)

fields.Participants: Govt Affairs Mgr, Leadership/Speakers, Marketing/Brand (links to VS-14.3), affected SMEs

workflows.name: Industry Event, Conference & Award Program Participation

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-log of "logistics, and brand presence" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-capture of "capture leads/insights/relationships from events, measure event ROI" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-542 (ensure controlled execution — Industry & Trade Association Relations (PA-104.2).)
- operational: curation and ROI tracking; operational: review
Pain Points / Risks: - **Low-ROI-event risk**: Events that consume cost/time without value; mitigated by curation and ROI tracking
- **Brand-misalignment risk**: Speaking/sponsoring at misaligned events; mitigated by review
System Touchpoints: - Event tracking; brand/marketing (links to VS-14.3); analytics (links to VS-28.1)

steps.activity: Govt Affairs Mgr curate the industry event/conference/award calendar: select high-value events (speaking, sponsorship, awards, networking) aligned to strategy and brand; prioritize executive/SME participation
Govt Affairs Mgr/Marketing manage participation: speaking slots, sponsorships, award submissions, delegation, logistics, and brand presence (coordinate with VS-14.3); prepare speakers and materials
Govt Affairs Mgr capture leads/insights/relationships from events, measure event ROI (W3367), and feed insights to strategy (links to VS-33.3) and innovation (links to VS-30)
